desc:
Welcome to Steal a Flying Pet! ☁️👾🥚

Ride your flying Pet to the sky islands, sneak past the sleeping Monsters, and steal their Eggs! But be careful... if a Monster wakes up, it will chase you! 😱

How to play:
🚀 Fly your Pet to the sky islands
🥚 Grab an Egg from a Monster's nest
😱 Fly home before the Monster catches you!
🐣 Hatch your Eggs to discover new Flying Pets
💵 Place your Pets at your base to earn Cash
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed and reach farther islands
⚡ Ride rarer Pets to fly even faster!
🏏 Bonk other players to make them drop their Eggs!
🏗️ Upgrade your base to hold even more Pets
🎯 Complete Goals on every island for free rewards!

💤 Your Pets keep earning Cash while you're offline!

♻️ Rebirth to multiply your earnings and fly even farther!

👍 Like the game and join the group to get a Legendary Pegasus and +10K Speed!
